**Unified Benchmark** 28| 29| We provide a unified benchmark toolbox for various semantic segmentation methods. 30| 31| - **Modular Design** 32| 33| We decompose the semantic segmentation framework into different components and one can easily construct a customized semantic segmentation framework by combining different modules. 34| 35| -
